collection.description: A treasured woven doll disappears, and suspicion falls on a child whose family owns few toys.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A treasured woven doll disappears, and suspicion falls on (suspect), a child whose family owns few toys.

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (an animal, a sound, a thing or a mark out of sight); nobody leaves the village -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The doll is found under a sleeping mat.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The search reveals a misunderstanding about borrowing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: One child admits taking it and fears punishment.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (owner) explains why the doll mattered so much.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child returns it and helps repair its torn arm.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (caregiver), a caregiver, limits unsupervised borrowing until trust improves.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Adults acknowledge that poverty was mistaken for guilt.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The children agree that fairness means evidence, not reputation.
